the rank property is a key component of RPL and it is vulnerable to attacks.
the rank property of 6LOWPANS RPL is susceptible to several vulnerabilities and hence, needs to be secured.
the rank property of the RPL protocol is vulnerable to various attacks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: 1) Identification of vulnerabilities of the Rank Property of RPL.
the security assessment of rank property and the construction of an Attack Graph to analyze all the vulnerabilities associated with it.
the security analysis of rank property in the context of RPL and the construction of an Attack Graph to assess the vulnerabilities of RPL.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the rank property is susceptible to attacks that can lead to sub-optimal routing, traffic disruption, resource consumption and isolation.
the security of IoT is a very complex issue.

our investigation of rank property vulnerabilities of RPL can be used to design mechanisms to ensure routing security in LLNs.
our analysis of the rank property in RRL6LOWPAN would help in the design and development of a secure routing protocol for LLNs.

the vulnerabilities of rank property can be used to launch several attacks in RPL.
